name: tiddlywiki-mermaid
description: Offline Mermaid v11+ diagram rendering plugin for TiddlyWiki5
author: mblackman

scripts.build-demo: cross-env TIDDLYWIKI_PLUGIN_PATH=plugins tiddlywiki demo --output dist --build index
scripts.build-all: npm run clean-runtime && npm run build:mermaid && npm run build-plugin && npm run build-demo && npm run clean-runtime
scripts.dev: npm run build:mermaid && cross-env TIDDLYWIKI_PLUGIN_PATH=plugins tiddlywiki demo --listen port=8080 host=127.0.0.1
